item: Frozen-branch reparameterization — declared rho_rock prior with derived zb
status: IMPLEMENTED in the config 2026-08-13 (branch_model block). Reviewer ratification of the new branch model still outstanding.
finding: Reviewer NEW-MAJOR-2: an explicit discrete model index with declared 0.5/0.5 prior odds does NOT cure the box-edge arbitrariness of the frozen branch — it RELABELS it. Fixing the branch PRIOR leaves each branch's EVIDENCE INTEGRAL running over whatever zb range was declared, and on the frozen branch that range IS a prior on rock density.

box_edge_dependence.reading: The reported ocean/no-ocean odds would have been linearly rescalable by a choice with no physical content — exactly the fragile statistic the NH3 C16 saga identified.

prior_distortion.mechanism: zb <-> rho_rock is a bijection on the frozen branch with d(rho_rock)/d(zb) ~ 22-28 kg m^-3 km^-1, so a UNIFORM prior in zb is NOT uniform in rho_rock.
prior_distortion.reading: A factor 2.0 tilt FAVOURING low-density rock — i.e. the old parameterization put its heaviest prior weight on the densities furthest from the H&M/Park requirement of 2340-2410.

fix_applied.zb_km: DERIVED by mass conservation from (rho_rock, rho_ice) — not sampled
fix_applied.why_this_fixes_it: The frozen support is now the mass-conservation image of a DECLARED density prior, so it is independent of any box edge, and the prior sits on the quantity that actually has literature constraints.

not_sampled_on_the_frozen_branch.log10_wOcean_ppt: no ocean -> salinity is UNDEFINED there, not merely unconstrained
not_sampled_on_the_frozen_branch.compensation_C2: no ice/ocean interface -> rigid uncompensated support via isostatic_gravity(R_b=None)

fix_applied.dimensionality: frozen 3 free parameters vs ocean 5 — the branches are NOT nested, so each evidence must be computed over its own support
fix_applied.ocean_branch_zb_prior_restored: [5, 45] km, its own support. The single continuous [5,70] axis of r2/r3 is retired.

required_validation: Recompute the discrete-index odds with the frozen density prior at U[2200,2600] vs a widened U[2100,2700]; the odds SHOULD now be insensitive to the zb reach, and only sensitive to the declared density prior — which is the intended, defensible dependence.
grid_consequence: The frozen segment spans the derived 47.45-65.26 km at 0.5 km (frozen nodes are discriminated at 23-45 sigma, so coarse is ample). The w axis applies to the OCEAN branch only; the builder must not multiply frozen zb nodes by 40 salinities.
